meta.name: NX Trading — remaining system build-out

stack.framework: Next.js 16.3.4 (App Router, Turbopack) — Next 16 differs from training data; consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before framework-level changes
stack.css: Tailwind CSS 4 via @tailwindcss/postcss (CSS vars + @theme inline; NO tailwind.config)

conventions.pageAnatomy: lib/<feature>.ts (types, seed, pure tick, stats) -> components/<feature>.x (stateless presentational) -> app/<route>/layout.tsx (server: metadata + default pass-through export) -> app/<route>/page.tsx (client orchestrator)
conventions.hydration: client pages gate first paint with useMounted() from components/framework.tsx and render <Splash /> until mounted (Math.random in initial state is unsafe otherwise)
conventions.liveData: client state + setInterval calling pure lib functions; pause via activeRef + useEffect so intervals don't restart; tape/state via useState (needs setter for ticks)
conventions.nav: add href to the matching item in components/chrome.tsx NAV (groups: Trading | Analytics | System)
conventions.uiKit: Panel, LiveDot, Delta, Badge (no 'dim'), Sparkline, Ring (tone = CSS color string, no 'label') from components/ui.tsx; usd() from components/panels.tsx
conventions.lintNote: npx next lint does NOT exist in Next 16 — use npx eslint .
conventions.typesNote: tsc needs .next/types present (LayoutProps generated): order is next build -> tsc -> eslint; stale .next/dev/types cause phantom errors — rm -rf .next then rebuild
conventions.subshellNote: use npx next start / npx next build in bash subshells (next not on PATH)

validationGate: npx next start -p <free-port> + curl new route -> HTTP 200
meta.howToUpdate: flip subtask/story/epic status as work lands (todo -> in-progress -> done); set epicStatus when all story stories are done; bump meta.updated and meta.version on each turn; overallStatus = done when final validation gate passes on all routes

epics.title: Positions
epics.summary: Portfolio of open positions: live unrealized P&L, exposure, per-position risk, close/half actions, realized-trade log, P&L attribution by symbol.

stories.title: Data layer

subtasks.text: Position type: id, symbol, side (LONG/SHORT), qty, entryPx, markPx, stopPx, targetPx, strategy, venue, openedAgeSec, marginUsed, leverage, realizedPnl, unrealizedPnl, mfe, mae, riskUsd (|mark-stop|*qty)
seedPositions(): 8-10 rows reusing lib/market.ts SEED_POSITIONS + strategy names; mix LONG/SHORT, crypto (-USD) + equities, varied entry/age
tickPositions(): drift markPx (±0.05-0.12%), recompute unrealizedPnl + mfe/mae; ~5% chance one position auto-closes (realized push to closes log, remove)
actOnPosition(positions, id, 'close' | 'half'): pure, returns {positions, closes}
stats: equity (1M base + realized), gross, net, unrealized, marginUsagePct, avgUnrealizedPct, worstUnrealized, openCount
bySymbol(): unrealized $ + exposure per symbol (for bars)

acceptance: all pure functions, strict tsc clean

stories.title: UI components

subtasks.text: KpiStrip (8 tiles): equity, gross, net, unrealized $+%, realized, margin usage, avg %, worst
PositionsTable: symbol+strategy, side chip, qty, entry, mark, stop, target, unrealized (Delta + bar), margin, lev, riskUsd, MFE/MAE mini-bars, age; desktop row actions ⚡Close / ½Half / ✕Stop
RealizedLog (cap 30): time, symbol, side, qty, px, pnl
PnlBySymbol diverging bars (long green / short rose)
ExposurePanel: long/short bars + net + margin Ring

acceptance: props-only components, no state, no new deps

subtasks.text: BacktestRun: id, label, strategy, symbol, timeframe (1m/5m/1h/1d), rangeText, params {lookback, threshold, maxPos, riskPct}, metrics {netPnl, sharpe, sortino, maxDD, winRate, profitFactor, trades, cagr}, equityCurve (64 numbers), drawdown (64 negative numbers)

rerun(run): jitter every metric 1.5-4% and regenerate curves => returns new run (id preserved)

MetricChip (value + tone band)

Scenario: {id, name (Vol spike +2σ, Gap down −6%, Correlation blow-up, Liquidity loss, Exchange outage, Model drift), severity 1-4, pnlDeltaUsd, varImpact, breachBoostByLimit {name→delta}}; applyScenario(limits, scen): stressed {pct, breached} per limit
